blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines — Detained Sen. Rodante Marcoleta on Monday said he no longer intends to join the impeachment trial of Vice President Sara Duterte, citing constitutional concerns over the proceedings. Marcoleta, who has been unable to attend a single day of Duterte’s trial, also reiterated his opposition to the designation of Sen. Francis Escudero as the Senate Impeachment Court’s presiding officer. “I am no longer inclined to seek participation in the impeachment trial of Vice President Sara Duterte, including its eventual deliberations leading to the voting, if the Impeachment Court ultimately proceeds in a way that will desecrate the Constitution,” Marcoleta […]...
